name: on-shift
description: ON SHIFT: one app, three shifts on one engine: the SOC alert triage game, SHIFTY-1 (AWS AI Practitioner) and the Ghost CISO (CISSP).

scripts.content: node ./node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs scripts/build-content.ts && node ./node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs scripts/build-content-ai.ts && node ./node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs scripts/build-content-cissp.ts && npm run quips
scripts.validate: node ./node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs scripts/build-content.ts --check && node ./node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs scripts/build-content-ai.ts --check && node ./node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs scripts/build-content-cissp.ts --check && npm run quips
scripts.build: npm run content && npm run typecheck && node ./node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build
